thread:
nina: Hey team — need to add my 20yo foster son to my medical plan. He arrived from India in May and is enrolled at a community college here. He doesn't have a SSN/TIN yet. What docs are required and is this a QLE (came to live with me)?

maya_peopleops: Hi Nina, yes that's typically a QLE (change in household). We'll need proof of relationship/guardianship, proof of residency (move-in date), and proof of student status if you're adding him as a student-dependent. For Indian documents, an official admission letter on school letterhead + a local lease or utility bill works. Translations required if not in English.

ryan_payroll: Payroll note: you can enroll without SSN/TIN for benefits processing. For payroll pretax deductions or IR reporting later we may ask for an ITIN — but we can add him now and follow up. Deductions will be prorated if mid-cycle.

benefits-bot: Upload all docs to Benefits Portal > Manage Dependents within 30 days of the QLE. Accepted: guardianship/court order, school admission letter, passport, visa/immigration docs, lease or mailbox utility with move-in date. If you don't have a guardianship order we accept a notarized caregiver affidavit + two supporting docs.

nina: I have a refugee intake document and a notarized caregiver affidavit, plus the college admission PDF. The intake doc is not on official letterhead — will that be ok?

maya_peopleops: Intake docs alone probably not sufficient. Please upload the affidavit + college admission letter + any US mail showing his address (postmarked letter, DMV doc, bank statement). If you can get a short letter from the intake agency on their letterhead that helps. We'll flag anything insufficient and request follow-ups.

hari_benefits: Process note: set QLE date to the date he began living full-time with you. If that date is within 30 days we can add him now. Effective coverage date is usually the 1st of the month after approval unless docs support retro coverage back to the move-in date. We'll confirm after verification.

nina: Move-in date was 2025-05-12. Uploaded affidavit, admission PDF, passport scan, and a scanned bank letter with address to case #34090. Also requested a signed letter from the intake agency.

benefits-bot: Case #34090 received. Documents queued for review. Expected response: 5 business days.

ryan_payroll: Thanks — bookkeeping note: if approved retro to 5/12, premium adjustments will be applied to upcoming payroll cycles and may show as catch-up charges. If you'd prefer to spread costs over next pay periods, let payroll know on the case.

maya_peopleops: We'll review and update the case. If we need translations or additional proof we'll request them here. If approved, we'll email confirmation and update your benefits summary. Ping us if anything urgent.

nina: Thank you all — appreciate the clear steps :raised_hands:
